definitions.gloss: volunteer; willing participant; person who steps forward
definitions.explanation: A person who voluntarily offers to participate in or support an activity, cause, or movement. Emphasizes the person's own initiative and willingness rather than being assigned or obligated.

examples.japanese: {有志者|ゆうししゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。
⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{有志者|ゆうししゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Volunteers gathered for the local cleanup activity.

examples.japanese: {有志者|ゆうししゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{合|あ}い、⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支援物資|しえんぶっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}けた→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: Volunteers pooled their funds together and delivered relief supplies to the disaster area.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{有志|ゆうし}→有志：13005_yuushi⟧ ('having a will; volunteering') and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ ('person'). The base word ⟦{有志|ゆうし}→有志：13005_yuushi⟧ alone is more commonly used to mean 'volunteers' or 'willing participants,' and {有志者|ゆうししゃ} adds the person suffix for extra clarity.

USAGE:
In practice, ⟦{有志|ゆうし}→有志：13005_yuushi⟧ without ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ is more common in everyday use. {有志者|ゆうししゃ} appears in slightly more formal or written contexts. Both can function identically in most sentences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有志者|ゆうししゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: to call for volunteers
- {有志者|ゆうししゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: volunteers gather
- {有志者|ゆうししゃ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧: donations by willing participants
- {有志者|ゆうししゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation of volunteers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有志|ゆうし}→有志：13005_yuushi⟧: volunteer(s) — the shorter and more common form; often used without ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧
- ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧: volunteer — the loanword; implies unpaid charitable work, while {有志者|ゆうししゃ} emphasizes willingness
- ⟦{志願者|しがんしゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧: applicant; person who volunteers — someone who formally applies, especially for military service or a position
- {篤志家|とくしか}: philanthropist; benefactor — someone who generously donates money or resources
